python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('vane_fs/build/prewriteback-waits-20261018')
b=json.loads((out/'build.json').read_text())
p=json.loads((out/'plan.json').read_text())
f=json.loads((out/'findings.json').read_text())
identities={}
for mapping in [b['inputs'],b['sources'],b['binaries'],p['inputs'],f['inputs']]:
 for path,sha in mapping.items():
  assert path not in identities or identities[path]==sha,path
  identities[path]=sha
for path,sha in identities.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha,path
for path,proof in b['reverse_proof'].items():
 text=Path(path).read_text()
 for before,after,count in reversed(proof['changes']):
  assert text.count(after)==count,(path,after)
  text=text.replace(after,before)
 assert text==Path(proof['original_path']).read_text(),path
for path,proof in b['recorder_reverse_proof'].items():
 text=Path(path).read_text()
 for before,after in reversed(proof['changes']):
  assert text.count(after)==1
  text=text.replace(after,before)
 assert text==Path(proof['original_path']).read_text(),path
text=(out/'run_fuse.py').read_text()
for before,after,count in reversed(p['runner_changes']):
 assert text.count(after)==count
 text=text.replace(after,before)
assert text==Path(b['template'],'run_fuse.py').read_text()
read_proof=json.loads((out/'read-workload-proof.json').read_text())
text=(out/'workload.py').read_text()
for before,after in reversed(read_proof['changes']):
 assert text.count(after)==1
 text=text.replace(after,before)
assert text==Path(b['template'],'workload.py').read_text()
assert f['mounts']==16 and len(f['final_fsyncs'])==32 and len(f['timed_reads'])==16
assert all(r['native_returned_bytes']==67108864 and r['eof_requests']==1 for r in f['timed_reads'])
raw=json.loads((out/'ext4-diagnostic/results.json').read_text())
assert raw['status']=='PASS' and raw['monitor_stopped']
cleanup=b['cleanup']+raw['cleanup']
assert len(cleanup)==18 and all(row['removed'] and not Path(row['path']).exists() for row in cleanup)
assert all(row.get('processes_stopped',row.get('process_stopped')) and row.get('mount_absent',True) for row in cleanup)
owned=out.resolve()
for path in Path('/proc').glob('[0-9]*/exe'):
 try: executable=path.resolve(strict=True)
 except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError,PermissionError): continue
 assert not executable.is_relative_to(owned),path
assert max(c['ended_epoch'] for c in b['commands'])<raw['started_epoch']<raw['ended_epoch']<=f['started_epoch']
print(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS',frozen_identities=len(identities),all_reverse_proofs_verified=True,production_unchanged=True,mounts=16,large_file_content_checks=32,cleanup_directories=18,all_owned_processes_stopped=True,measurement_rerun=False,free_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(out).free)))
